title: 第26章 沼泽边的脚印
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
第二天天还没亮，苏荇就把林尘从炼丹室里拖了出来。

    “铁背犀每天清晨会巡逻一次，路线固定——从沼泽深处沿高地走到枯木，绕过芦苇丛，再沿溪流折返。整个过程大约一炷香。它巡逻的时候不会主动攻击，但任何闯入领地的修士都会被它视为威胁。”她把昨晚画好的灵力丝线分布图塞进林尘手里，又从药柜里翻出两个备用的学徒炉塞进背包，“动作快点，天亮了就错过巡逻时间了。”

    林尘把刻好符阵的青铜炉背在背上，两人沿着后山小路摸到沼泽边缘。

    清晨的雾气还没散，芦苇丛湿漉漉地垂着穗子，水面偶尔冒出一串气泡，不知是鱼还是别的什么。

    苏荇蹲在一丛灌木后面，拨开枝叶往沼泽深处看。

    “那边。”她压低声音。

    铁背犀正从沼泽深处缓缓走出。

    庞大的身躯像一座移动的灰黑色山丘，背甲上的岩质鳞片在晨雾中泛着冷光。

    每一步都踩得泥地往下陷，蹄印深得能埋到膝盖。

    它走到枯木前停下来，低头嗅了嗅树根，然后转过身背对枯木，面朝沼泽方向——软肉暴露的角度正是苏荇昨晚画的最佳攻击位置。

    然后它继续往前走，绕过芦苇丛，消失在溪流方向。

    “它每天都会在枯木前停一次，每次停的时间不长——大概六七息。停的时候头会低下去嗅树根，软肉正好暴露在枯木正侧面。就是这里。”苏荇指了指枯木树干上一道被撞裂的旧痕，“上次你说在树干上画炭笔圈，位置不用变了——铁背犀自己选择了这个角度，我们只需要把银叶花麻痹液涂在它习惯嗅的位置，剩下的等它自己送上门。”

    “锁灵阵的激活需要提前放在枯木根部。”林尘把青铜炉从背上卸下来。

    炉底的御灵符阵和锁灵阵在晨雾中泛着淡金色的微光。

    “激活之后三息内会有一股灵力波动，铁背犀会感知到并抬头，软肉暴露时间延长到三息。三息够我从密林边缘冲到枯木正侧面，瞄准，出手。”

    “三息够你跑多远。”
content_en:
Before dawn the next day, Su Yun dragged Lin Chen out of the alchemy room.

    "The iron-backed rhinoceros will patrol once every morning, with a fixed route - from the depths of the swamp, along the high ground to the dead wood, around the reeds, and back along the stream. The whole process takes about one stick of incense. It will not actively attack when patrolling, but any monk who intrudes into the territory will be regarded as a threat by it." She put the spiritual power thread distribution map she drew last night into Lin Chen's hand, and took out two spare apprentice stoves from the medicine cabinet and stuffed them into her backpack. "Hurry up, otherwise you will miss the patrol time at dawn."

    Lin Chen carried the bronze furnace with the talisman carved on his back, and the two of them walked along the back mountain path to the edge of the swamp.

    The early morning fog has not yet dissipated, the reeds have wet tassels hanging down, and a string of bubbles occasionally appear on the water surface. I don't know if they are fish or something else.

    Su Yun squatted behind a bush, pushed aside the branches and leaves, and looked into the depths of the swamp.

    "Over there." She lowered her voice.

    The iron-backed rhinoceros is slowly emerging from the depths of the swamp.

    The huge body was like a moving gray-black hill, and the rocky scales on its back shone coldly in the morning mist.

    The mud sank with every step, and the hoof prints were so deep that they could reach the knees.

    It stopped in front of the dead tree, lowered its head and sniffed the roots, then turned its back to the dead tree and faced the direction of the swamp - the angle where the soft flesh was exposed was the best attack position Su Xin drew last night.

    Then it moved on, skirting the reeds and disappearing in the direction of the stream.

    "It stops in front of a dead tree once a day, and each time it stops for a short time - about six or seven breaths. When it stops, it lowers its head to sniff the tree roots, and the soft flesh is exposed just on the side of the dead tree. This is where it is." Su Yun pointed to a strip of quilt on the trunk of the dead tree. The old cracked marks, "Last time you said that the position of drawing a charcoal circle on the tree trunk does not need to be changed - the iron-backed rhinoceros chose this angle on its own. We only need to apply the silver leaf flower paralyzing liquid to the place where it is accustomed to sniffing, and wait for it to deliver the rest to the door."

    "The activation of the spirit locking array needs to be placed at the roots of the dead wood in advance." Lin Chen took off the bronze furnace from his back.

    The spirit-taming talisman array and the spirit-locking array at the bottom of the furnace glowed with a pale golden light in the morning mist.

    "After activation, there will be a spiritual power fluctuation within three breaths. The iron-backed rhinoceros will sense it and raise its head, and the exposure time of the soft flesh will be extended to three breaths. Three breaths is enough for me to rush from the edge of the dense forest to the side of the dead tree, aim, and take action."

    "Three breaths are enough for you to run as far as you want."
title_en: Chapter 26 Footprints on the edge of the swamp
